name: ContextMenu
summary: Actions menu opened by right-click or long-press.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 27/08/2026, with the menu OPENED by right click — measuring keys on a closed trigger measures a menu that does not exist. ArrowLeft, ArrowUp, Home and End were delivered and not declared. Enter is declared and showed no observable change in this snapshot; it activates the highlighted item, and with no item highlighted there is nothing to observe.

props.name: children
props.description: The region that answers the right button. It is rendered focusable (tabIndex 0) on purpose: the keyboard route into a context menu is Shift+F10 or the Menu key, and the browser only fires those over a FOCUSED element. Without that, the menu is mouse-only.

props.name: items
props.description: The menu, as data: {label, onClick?, disabled?, leadingIcon?}. The literal string "separator" draws a rule — a separator is not an item, so it never takes focus.

props.name: label
props.description: Names both the trigger region and the menu. A right-click target with no name is announced as nothing at all.

props.name: className
props.description: Goes on the trigger region, which is the element you can see.
